scope: Corollary 3.4 (Balanced corner parities) of the manuscript “Conformal Limits of Critical Square-Lattice Random-Cluster Interfaces” (preprints/Conformal-Limits-of-Critical-Square-Lattice-Random-Cluster-Interfaces-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b14b09c2088272ae), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 20-21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let a fixed simple rectilinear polygon have m concave and m + 4 convex true corners, with wire changes in side interiors. It has tile approximants differing by O(1) mesh units such that at least ⌊m/2⌋ corners of each relative wire type occur in each of the convex and concave sets, also after global wire reversal. For these approximants, 3P + D∗ + X v convex Ci(v) + X v concave Li(v) ≤ 1 2 P − 3 2 D∗ + o(log n). (3.17) 20 Each fixed family of negative endpoint charges with magnitudes summing to one has total wrong-to-correct local logarithmic cost at most −P + o(log n).
